back: All businesses in the chain from farm inputs to the consumer: input supply, farming, processing, marketing and retail.
Raising the value of a farm product by processing, grading, packaging or branding so that it sells for more.
Value added = sales − cost of raw materials. Profit = value added − processing costs.
A buyer agrees in advance to purchase the crop, often supplying inputs on credit that are deducted at harvest.
Guaranteed market, inputs on credit, technical advice and less price risk.
Low fixed prices, deductions, dependence on one buyer and side-selling disputes.
Groundnuts to peanut butter, tomatoes to sauce, maize to mealie meal, milk to cheese and yoghurt, cotton to lint and cloth.
The Zimbabwe International Trade Fair in Bulawayo and agricultural shows let producers display products and meet buyers.
Capital, electricity and water, standards, roads and storage, marketing skills and competition.
